page_title: LEV 2-1 FRE | Bayer Leverkusen v Freiburg 29/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniel Siebert ignores the protests.
90+3' Referee Daniel Siebert has finally had enough of Christian Streich and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90+3' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+2' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alejandro Grimaldo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen).
90' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a change. Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) replaces Florian Wirtz.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) for Victor Boniface.
88' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
88' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Freiburg get a corner.
85' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Jeremie Frimpong is replaced by Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen).
85' The referee signals a substitution. Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is brought on as a substitute for Jonas Hofmann.

84' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
83' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) will take the corner.
81' Christian Streich decides to make a substitution. Merlin Rohl will be replaced by Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
81' Here comes a substitution. Vincenzo Grifo is given a rest as he is replaced by Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg).
81' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.

80' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) misses a golden opportunity to score from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
74' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner kick.
73' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

70' 2 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Vincenzo Grifo flights in the free kick and the ball finds the head of Manuel Gulde (Freiburg), whose excellent bullet header from the centre of the box goes into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
70' It seemed like Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
67' Christian Streich has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) replacing Philipp Lienhart.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) comes onto the pitch so that Maximilian Eggestein can be given a rest.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Freiburg comes to nothing.
65' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

60' 2 - 0 Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to an excellent pass just outside the box. He thunders the ball towards the left-hand post and it bounces off the base of it into the back of the net.
57' Bayer Leverkusen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

57' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' A pass by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
52' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
50' A snap shot by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Noah Atubolu produces a good save to thwart him.
46' Referee Daniel Siebert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The resulting set piece from Bayer Leverkusen is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner kick.

36' 1 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom left corner and makes it 1:0. Noah Atubolu was helpless.
35' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box.
33' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
32' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
31' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Bayer Leverkusen out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
29' A corner kick by Bayer Leverkusen is thwarted by the well prepared Noah Atubolu (Freiburg).
28' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. Bayer Leverkusen will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
28' Bayer Leverkusen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
28' A quickly taken corner by Bayer Leverkusen.
25' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
21' Bayer Leverkusen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
21' Bayer Leverkusen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

20' Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
19' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
15' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
14' Daniel Siebert shows a yellow card to Lukas Kubler (Freiburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
13' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniel Siebert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
11' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
7' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

7' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayer Leverkusen.

4' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayer Leverkusen.
4' Bayer Leverkusen are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
